From: Lucy Chen <lucy@cartwave.ai>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com, diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Hosted API eval — sandbox & demo?

Hi Sofia / Diego,

I signed up for the self-serve sandbox yesterday (Cartwave — ML-powered checkout personalization). We're evaluating hosted inference for a small pilot: low-latency text completions for product copy + embeddings for similarity ranking.

Before we commit credits, could we grab a quick live walkthrough of the Hosted API and a short sandbox orientation? Ideally a 30-min session next week in PT. My availability: Tue 6/27 10:00–12:00 PT, Wed 6/28 14:00–17:00 PT, or Thu 6/29 morning.

Two quick questions to save time on the call:
- Typical latency / tail behavior for 1–2k token requests on the smaller models?
- Can the sandbox be preloaded with ~5k product descriptions (we can share a sample CSV) and an embedding token quota for testing?

Thanks — looking forward to a pragmatic walkthrough.

— Lucy
Lucy Chen
Head of Growth, Cartwave
lucy@cartwave.ai

We can absolutely run a short concierge walkthrough and get the sandbox prepped with a small product CSV for embeddings. Proposed 30-min windows (PT):
- Tue 6/27 10:30–11:00
- Wed 6/28 14:30–15:00
- Thu 6/29 09:00–09:30

If any of those work I can send a calendar invite and loop in Mina (solutions engineer) for a short preflight on your CSV and test prompts. Attaching a very short pre-demo checklist that covers sandbox quotas, sample payloads, and expected logs we'll capture during the session.

Pre-demo asks (just a couple):
- One or two representative prompts you want us to run (product copy + a short prompt for embeddings).
- A small sample CSV (<=500 rows) so Mina can stage it in the sandbox before the call.

I'll hold the first slot tentatively for you until EOD PT. If you want a tighter 20-min run we can compress the agenda.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
